Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful
My God, by the right of those who whispered to You

Arabic text: وَ بِحَقِّ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِيْ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ
Translation: And by the right of those who called upon You on land and sea

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْغَنَاءِ وَ الثَّرْوَةِ
Translation: And bestow upon the poor believing men and women with richness and wealth

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَرْضَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالشِّفَاءِ وَ الصِّحَّةِ
Translation: And upon the sick believing men and women with healing and health

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى اَحْيَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِاللُّطْفِ وَ الْكَرَمِ
Translation: And upon the living believing men and women with kindness and generosity

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى اَمْوَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: And upon the deceased believing men and women with forgiveness and mercy

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى غُرَبَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالرَّدِّ اِلَى اَوْطَانِهِمْ سَالِمِيْنَ غَانِمِيْنَ
Translation: And upon the traveling believing men and women with safe return to their homelands with success and gains
By Muhammad and his entire family
